ecuparam.name: External Wideband AFR (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Master-patch external-wideband value at FFFFB098, presented primarily as gasoline AFR using 14.64 stoich. The former MAF ADC feeds both synthetic front feedback banks. A raw value of 0.0 is the firmware fault sentinel and must never be interpreted as a real AFR.

ecuparam.name: External Wideband Input ADC (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Unsigned former-MAF ADC at FFFFAB06. Use counts/volts to compare the ECU-referenced B136-23 input with the controller's white-to-black output and diagnose wiring, ground offset, or clipping; an in-range value does not prove controller health.

ecuparam.name: External Wideband Ready Metric (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Master-patch synthetic voltage-window metric at FFFFAE70. Firmware publishes 50.0 for an input inside the configured plausibility window and 0.0 outside it. It is not controller/sensor health. Closed-loop feedback requires greater than 35.0; EBCS duty additionally requires valid MAP/RPM/IAT, minimum control RPM, and a non-fault speed-density result.

ecuparam.name: Committed AVLS VE State (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Committed AVLS mode byte at FFFFCD86 used directly by the dual-VE airflow wrapper. Value 1 is low lift and value 3 is high lift. Filter VE correction logs by this committed state and discard samples around the transition; do not substitute requested state. This is a software selection rather than confirmation of hydraulic lift. E526/E527 expose the separately updated bank copies.

ecuparam.name: Lean Fuel Cut State (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Latched lean-protection state at FFFFC860: 0 disarmed; 1 post-turbo sensor delay; 2 monitoring AFR; 3 fuel-cut latched. With the corrected wrapper state 3 releases only when MAP minus selected baro is at or below reset and reset is less than arm. Invalid hysteresis keeps the cut latched. E525 exposes the composed injector-inhibit word.

ecuparam.name: Lean Fuel Cut Counter (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Current post-turbo transport-delay or consecutive-lean confirmation count at FFFFC85C. Counts periodic task calls, not milliseconds; log it to calibrate the installed sensor delay.

ecuparam.name: CL/OL State Flags (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw stock closed-loop/open-loop state byte at FFFFBE38. Pressure safety clears bit 0x80 to revoke closed-loop permission; use the stock logger's final fueling status where available for a human-readable state.

ecuparam.name: Engine Run Counter (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Stock saturating engine-run counter at FFFFB688. It increments in periodic task 9 and resets while the engine-not-running state is active. The derived 8 ms/count uses native CMT1 settings and the eight-tick task divider at the project's nominal 40 MHz CPU clock. This is not a measured task period; confirm elapsed counts from a capture.

ecuparam.name: After-Start Fuel Group A (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw additive after-start fueling state at FFFFB834, published by the Ghidra-identified group-A decay path and consumed by final fueling. Log from before cranking until the lean trend is complete.

ecuparam.name: After-Start Fuel Group B (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw additive after-start fueling state at FFFFB854, published by the Ghidra-identified group-B decay path and consumed by final fueling. Log from before cranking until the lean trend is complete.

ecuparam.name: After-Start Fuel Compensation A (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw after-start fueling compensation state at FFFFB868, published by the Ghidra-identified B868 update path and consumed by final fueling.

ecuparam.name: Transient Load Fuel Correction (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Signed additive load-change correction at FFFFB874, produced by 1E7E8 and consumed by final fueling. Positive values add fuel and negative values remove fuel. It remains active after startup and updates once per 120 crank degrees; the old after-start-only label was incorrect.

ecuparam.name: After-Start Fuel Group C (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw group-C after-start fueling output at FFFFBE40. Its Ghidra-identified residual path uses the engine-run counter and a 5000-call calibration before the residual state decays; final fueling consumes this output.

ecuparam.name: After-Start Fuel Group D (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw group-D after-start fueling output at FFFFBE48, published by the Ghidra-identified group-D update path and consumed by final fueling.

ecuparam.name: Effective Idle Speed Target (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: RPM target at FFFFC468 published by 2C510 after the coolant-selected C460 target passes through 2C2D8 and the C4E8/C46C/C478 limits. Consumed by the stock idle control routines. This is the requested speed and does not indicate whether idle control is active.

ecuparam.name: Combined Throttle Request (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Combined plate request at FFFFC2B8 from 2AB06 including the idle path through C2C4. Scaled from the native 84-degree range to percent. This precedes the learned offset and fault overrides in 2AAAC that publish C2B4; it is not motor duty or proof of actual plate tracking. E57/C3D0 is the earlier torque-map request and omits this combined idle path.

ecuparam.name: Throttle and Idle Flags (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw FFFFB2BC flags from throttle processing at 14DCC. Bit 1 (mask 2) is the recognized-idle flag returned by 15192 and used by the idle/base ignition selector. Other bits retain their native meanings; decode offline without treating the whole byte as a boolean.

ecuparam.name: Idle Air Feedback Flags (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw FFFFC4D9 idle-air state from 2C760 and the output limiter 2D1FC. Bit 3 (mask 8) permits idle pressure feedback; C4D6 must also be at its update boundary for a new output. Bit 0 (mask 1) is the eligibility state. Decode masks offline; other bits retain native meanings. This is distinct from E516 ignition-idle flags and does not measure actual airflow.

ecuparam.name: SD Native MAP Input (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Direct sensor-converted absolute MAP at FFFFABC4 from 7A14. This is the SD wrapper input in native mmHg. Unlike stock E51 at B2A0 it has not passed through 1496C history processing or load-derived MAP substitution. Neither channel is an independent physical pressure reference.

ecuparam.name: MAP Sensor Input ADC (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Unsigned physical MAP ADC copy at FFFFAB04 from hardware FFFFF804. The native 7A14 converter passes it through ABC8 with the installed 256/256 coefficient before converting to ABC4. Volts use the nominal 5 V ADC reference; actual reference and ground accuracy remain unmeasured.

ecuparam.name: Selected Barometric Estimate (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Selected barometric pressure at FFFFCFBC in native mmHg. Installed selector 737D9=0 uses stored MAP-derived estimate 8E04. This is not an independent barometer; 47DCC can sample MAP or learn from processed MAP plus pressure-loss compensation and clamps the estimate to 570..770 mmHg.

ecuparam.name: MAP Fallback Diagnostic Flags (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw FFFFD26C byte. Mask 16 makes getter 64FBC return 2: 1496C substitutes load-derived processed MAP and 47DCC uses 760 mmHg baro. Writer 63174 consults current P0068/P0107/P0108 status under its diagnostic-mode gate. Other masks retain native meanings.

ecuparam.name: Airflow Diagnostic Flags (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw FFFFD26F byte. Mask 64 makes the shared stock getter 65168 return 2. The installed SD patch redirects the load task's local getter to constant zero, so this flag cannot activate its old processed-MAP-derived load substitution. Other stock consumers retain their use of this diagnostic state. This is not the added SD wrapper's fixed 500 g/s fallback flag.

ecuparam.name: Barometric Update Flags (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw FFFFCFD0 byte. Under normal MAP diagnostic status 47DCC prioritizes mask 128 for direct MAP sampling then mask 64 for filtered running learning then mask 32 for a 2.5 mmHg increment; otherwise it holds its prior estimate. All outputs are clamped to 570..770 mmHg. Other masks retain native meanings.

ecuparam.name: Accelerator Pedal Angle (4-byte)*
ecuparam.desc: E524-Direct 4-byte float conditioned accelerator pedal percent at FFFFB46C.

ecuparam.name: Injector Inhibit Word (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Unsigned native injector-inhibit word at FFFFB744; produced by 1C5D4 and read by 26DFC. Masks 1/2/4/8/16/32 inhibit individual scheduler channels; 65535 inhibits all channels. Added lean and overboost cuts also publish 65535 under the scheduler lock. A nonzero value does not identify its cause; E504 identifies the added lean-cut state. This is software permission rather than measured electrical injector duration. Separate SSM byte reads can straddle an update.

ecuparam.name: AVLS Bank 0 Software Mode (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Bank-index-0 software mode at FFFFCD89. Phase-qualified gate 405CC copies committed CD86 here before calling bank-0 output stages 40C94/40798/40CE6. This bank corresponds to the standard P123/P125 Right OSV channels; harness-side assignment is not independently established here. Mode 1 is low and 3 is high. This is not hydraulic lift feedback; brief disagreement with E503 or E527 can reflect normal phased updates or SSM sampling.

ecuparam.name: AVLS Bank 1 Software Mode (D2WD610H diagnostic)*
ecuparam.desc: Bank-index-1 software mode at FFFFCD8A. Phase-qualified gate 405CC copies committed CD86 here before calling bank-1 output stages 40C94/40798/40CE6. This bank corresponds to the standard P124/P126 Left OSV channels; harness-side assignment is not independently established here. Mode 1 is low and 3 is high. This is not hydraulic lift feedback; brief disagreement with E503 or E526 can reflect normal phased updates or SSM sampling.
